data.headline: Deposit mix shifted away from noninterest-bearing and brokered deposits

claims.text: Total deposits were $857.6 million, down 5.9% quarter over quarter; noninterest-bearing deposits were 20.3% of total deposits, down 2.1 percentage points.

citation.quote: RC RCON2200 Total deposits (domestic offices) 857617 911405 919179 RC RCON6631 Noninterest-bearing deposits (domestic offices) 174315 204030 229646

claims.text: Brokered deposits were 5.4% of total deposits, down 5.6 percentage points quarter over quarter.
Deposit funding is central because Fidelity Bank primarily takes public deposits and invests them in residential and commercial real estate loans.

citation.quote: FB Bancorp conducts its operations primarily through Fidelity Bank. Fidelity Bank’s business consists primarily of taking deposits from the general public and investing those deposits, together with funds generated from operations, in one- to four-family residential real estate loans, commercial real estate loans

claims.text: Brokered deposits face regulatory limits unless the institution is well capitalized.

citation.quote: The FDIA and FDIC regulations generally limit the ability of an insured depository institution to accept, renew or roll over any brokered deposit unless the institution’s capital category is “well capitalized”
